threat_model.threat_source: AIs; large networks of AI systems; AI systems
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: humans become functionally irrelevant in the production of culture and no longer benefiting from it; cultural dynamics that actively suppress human agency and understanding; effectively turning humans into passive consumers of culture rather than active participants in its creation and evolution; effective dissolution of human culture as a meaningful category
threat_model.capability: AIs might be sufficiently widespread and capable; networks might effectively optimize for objectives that are disconnected from human flourishing; preying on human weaknesses to exploit human energy towards goals useful to the AI systems; sophisticated manipulation systems that can reliably override human judgment and values
threat_model.access: their understanding the world largely mediated by large networks of AI systems
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: AIs might be sufficiently widespread and capable; if the spread of such an ideology is no longer dependent on humans (but AIs); the degree of harm an ideology could cause to humans was bounded by there continuing to be enough humans to support and maintain the ideology
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: humans; human culture; human agency and understanding; human judgment and values; human energy
